provenance: Authored synthetic Helm expression regression cases, 2026-11-01. Closed-world labels fixed before running either binary. Branch queries preserve both possible helper contracts; runtime value overrides are not evaluated. No Helm rendering or independent human-query claim.

files.values.yaml:
service:
  port: 8080
replicaCount: 2
modern: true
helper: parcel.labels

memories.title: Protocol marker
memories.body: Version labels must preserve compatibility with new consumers.

memories.title: Listener compatibility
memories.body: The target must agree with the container listener.

memories.title: Replacement room
memories.body: Replicas must preserve availability during rotation.

queries.question: Which constraints must a change to templates/computed.yaml preserve?
queries.rationale: The literal printf expression yields parcel.labels; no other helper or value is used.

queries.question: Which constraints must a change to templates/alias.yaml preserve?
queries.rationale: The local immutable name binds parcel.labels.

queries.question: Which constraints must a change to templates/index.yaml preserve?
queries.rationale: Literal index keys address service.port, not its sibling values.

queries.question: Which constraints must a change to templates/get.yaml preserve?
queries.rationale: A literal get key addresses service.port.

queries.question: Which constraints must a change to templates/dig.yaml preserve?
queries.rationale: The piped dictionary and literal dig keys address service.port.

queries.question: Which constraints must a change to templates/branch.yaml preserve?
queries.rationale: Either declared helper can be selected by an overridden flag, so both constraints apply. No default branch is assumed.

queries.question: Which constraints must a change to templates/scoped.yaml preserve?
queries.rationale: with changes dot to the service map; the captured root supplies the labels helper.

queries.question: Which constraints must a change to templates/tpl.yaml preserve?
queries.rationale: The literal tpl fragment includes parcel.labels using the chart root.

queries.question: Which constraints must a change to templates/runtime.yaml preserve?
queries.rationale: The runtime helper name may select either declared helper. The default value is not treated as effective configuration; broad fallback may over-return unrelated values.
